title: 한국해양과학기술원법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Management and Use of Donations, etc.)
(1) Where a donor has designated the purpose of a donation under Article 18 (1) of the Act, KIOST shall use the donation solely for that purpose: Provided, That where special circumstances make such use difficult, it may use the donation for another purpose with the donor's consent.
(2) Where KIOST and a donor jointly use land, research facilities, research equipment, or other donated assets pursuant to Article 18 (3) of the Act, they shall enter into an agreement.
(3) KIOST shall maintain books concerning the receipt and use of donations and take necessary measures to enable donors to inspect them.
(4) Within 90 days after the end of each fiscal year, KIOST shall submit a business performance report or financial statements concerning the receipt and use of donations during the preceding fiscal year to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended on March 24, 2013>
(5) Detailed matters necessary for the use of donations for purposes other than those designated, execution of joint-use agreements, inspection of books, and submission of financial statements under paragraphs (1) through (4) shall be prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended on March 24, 2013>
